title: Farming, breeding, and laborers
items: Water one crop or nurture one animal. Seed yield and offspring stay at the normal rate until you do.
Focus spent shows after you water or nurture, and it follows your mastery and that item's specialization.
Breeding has an Animal Breeder mastery list, the same way crops and herbs do.
fixed: Laborer returns follow the house tier and the journal tier, and journal prices load from the market.
